blacklistabilityReview.evidence: sreUSD is Upstream through its 100% parent claim on reUSD. Ethereum holds 100% of circulating supply. At Ethereum block 26224760 (2026-10-19T06:14:11Z; hash 0x2a6c0b20faae49bb23f77a582b517057741efcee5bd423a8552f672144c83b85), 0x557ab1e003951a73c12d16f0fea8490e39c33c35 matches verified nonproxy SavingsReUSD runtime, with zero EIP-1967 implementation/admin/beacon slots. SavingsReUSD, LinearRewardsErc4626 and Solmate ERC20/ERC4626 code expose no holder blacklist, transfer pause, seizure, upgrade or arbitrary-holder burn. Withdrawals burn shares under ordinary allowance rules; maxWithdraw/maxRedeem are balance-based, without configurable owner/receiver allowlists or withdrawal-limit modules. Owner 0xc07e000044f95655c11fda4cd37f70a94d7e0a7d and reward/bridge configuration do not authorize freezing local holder balances; msgInspector is zero. asset() is reUSD 0x57ab1e0003f623289cd798b1824be09a793e4bec, so the denominator is the entire 100% reUSD parent claim, not a separate portfolio. At the same block reUSD's 22-pair debt denominator is 52,735,322.818011773103279034 debt units: 99.1324141545% crvUSD-backed and 0.8675858455% frxUSD-backed. crvUSD's external-only reserve test at block 26224667 establishes Upstream and frxUSD has direct issuer controls, making reUSD 100% qualifying categorically. sreUSD inherits that parent exposure in full. The v4.4 sensitivity classified crvUSD and consequently reUSD as No and left sreUSD without qualifying parent inheritance; self-leg exclusion changes the upstream chain, not the wrapper's local permissions.

oracleRisk.summary: sreUSD values local shares from onchain REUSD custody and vested-reward accounting. It has no local collateral-liquidation engine or external market-price oracle; parent price and upstream mechanism risk remain inherited.

branchApplicability.rationale: The ERC-4626 share-to-underlying exchange rate is the top-level mint/redemption authority. There are no borrower-owned collateral branches on the savings token.
